events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, born Farrokh Bulsara, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true showman and a voice like no other.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring generations with her distinctive sound.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mancunian Legend
angles.copy: Alright, alright, alright! Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still got that swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, with the single following in October.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped, changing everything about portable music.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007 and 64 years of cinematic espionage.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental masterpiece, 'The White Album.' Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years on, the voice and spirit of Freddie Mercury continue to inspire. His legacy truly is immortal.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations. A true classic.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring message of peace.
